fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Product image URL or Base64-encoded image data (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: topNumber
fields.description: Maximum number of YOLO bounding boxes to return (default 5, maximum 100). The actual result count may be lower

fields.name: productTitle
fields.description: Product title used for context-aware detection (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: trademarkName
fields.description: Possible graphic-logo name used to narrow the search (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: regions
fields.description: Comma-separated country or region codes to inspect. Defaults to all regions. Supported values: US (United States), WO (WIPO), ES (Spain), GB (United Kingdom), DE (Germany), IT (Italy), CA (Canada), MX (Mexico), EM (European Union), AU (Australia), FR (France), JP (Japan), TR (Turkey), BX (Benelux), and CN (China)

fields.name: enableLocalizing
fields.description: Whether to enable image cropping (default false)

fields.name: enableRadar
fields.description: Whether to enable radar monitoring (default true)
